name: Hip Abductor (Machine)
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your legs against the outer pads.
Set a light-to-moderate weight and sit tall.
Push your knees apart as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly without letting the weights slam.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A seated machine exercise that presses the knees outward to train the glute medius and hip abductors.
